publishedExpectations.claim: Careers page: 'If you are driven to succeed, eager to take on new challenges and open to collaborating with colleagues in pursuit of excellence, you'll discover a wealth of exciting career opportunities at Morgan Stanley.'
For experienced professionals: 'If you can lead, solve problems and innovate, we want you on our team.'
The careers page advertises paths for students and graduates (internships, analyst programs) and states the firm spans 41 countries with 82k employees.
Morgan Stanley's business pages describe Sales and Trading that provides 'sales, trading and market-making services', the institutional context for quant-dev work.

notes: Morgan Stanley's retrieved careers page is values-and-breadth oriented: it names technologist paths, analyst programmes for students and graduates, and a problem-solving/innovation bar for experienced hires, but publishes no interview format. Community-reported patterns (unverified): recorded video interviews (HireVue), aptitude/numerical tests for some programmes, and division-specific technical interviews for quant seats; treat formats and test names as unconfirmed. Quant-dev work concentrates around Institutional Securities (sales & trading, market-making and risk), so derivatives, markets vocabulary and production-quality engineering are reasonable prep priorities. The firm's global footprint (41 countries, 82k employees) is sourced.
